III. Reading passage (Questions 32–37)

Read the text and choose the correct answer. (Đọc văn bản và chọn câu trả lời đúng)

Article

Music and Arts in Our Life

Music and arts are very popular activities for young people. Many students like listening to music, playing instruments, painting, and taking photos. Some prefer classical music, while others like pop music. Painting is different from photography, but both are creative activities.

Students often go to art galleries or music festivals to enjoy their hobbies. These activities help them relax and express their feelings. Many students say music and arts make their life more interesting.
